WHO Warnings and Guidelines: The World Health Organization (WHO) has issued strict advisories, urging public caution, mask mandates, social distancing, and heightened vigilance in crowded places.

Government and Airport Screening: Health authorities globally, including Indian medical boards, are monitoring international arrivals, preparing testing kits, and enforcing isolation protocols to prevent a massive wave.

The Tragic Incident: A major train accident occurred near the Digaru railway station in Guwahati, Assam, where several coaches derailed during a track change.

Viral Loco Pilot Video: A terrifying video of the loco pilot shouting in panic—stating that the brakes completely failed ("Kuch bhi kaam nahi kar raha")—went viral across social media.

Injuries and Rescue Operations: Multiple passengers sustained injuries, and local authorities immediately rushed relief teams, medical supplies, and ordinary bogies to evacuate the victims to nearby hospitals.

Investigation into Brake Failure: Railway authorities formed a high-level technical committee to investigate whether the sudden brake failure was due to technical malfunction or a deliberate conspiracy.

Current Status and Track Restoration: Senior officials are closely monitoring the rescue operations, clearing the derailed coaches from the tracks, and suspending connecting train services while interrogating the crew.

Trump’s Return & US Immigration: Impact on H-1B Visas Explained by Bhumi Reddy Sai Srinivas Reddy


Trump’s Impact on H-1B & Immigration: Analyzed the shifting political landscape in the US following mid-term shifts, discussing whether softer political tones will translate into actual immigration policy changes or stricter vetting.

H-1B Processing Delays & 240-Day Rule: Addressed extended processing times ranging from 8 to 12 months, highlighting the legal ambiguities surrounding the 240-day extension limit and why premium processing is recommended.

STEM OPT & H4 EAD Restrictions: Detailed the tightening regulations for STEM OPT students—emphasizing strict job-to-degree alignment, pay-stub verification, and legal risks—alongside updates on H4 EAD processing timelines.

The 100-Year Green Card Backlog: Explained the country-cap system affecting Indian nationals, shedding light on why Indian applicants face massive backlogs compared to other countries despite equal annual allocations.

Visa Stamping Fears & Student Advice: Discussed the scarcity of visa stamping dates, the challenges of 221(g) administrative processing, and provided encouraging guidance for prospective Indian students navigating US higher education.
